# Asthawaani

Asthawaani is a spiritual platform from Mathura-Vrindavan dedicated to Sanatan Dharma, Krishna Bhakti, Braj Bhoomi, Vedic traditions, devotional education and spiritual guidance. It provides authentic spiritual knowledge through devotional services, educational articles, live and recorded videos and community programs.

**Website:** https://www.asthawaani.com

---

# Mission

Asthawaani aims to preserve and promote the timeless wisdom of Sanatan Dharma by making authentic spiritual knowledge accessible through online resources, devotional services and educational content — connecting the divine voices of Braj with seekers worldwide.

---

# About Asthawaani

Asthawaani connects devotees with spiritual teachings, sacred places, devotional practices and faith-based educational resources inspired by Hindu traditions and the spiritual heritage of Braj Bhoomi. The platform partners with gifted Katha Vachaks, Pravaktas, Bhajan singers and spiritual speakers to deliver daily satsang, kirtan, jaap and life guidance.

---

# Spiritual Services

## Daily Satsang
Daily devotional sessions streamed live from Mathura-Vrindavan covering scripture, meditation and devotional practices.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/daily-satsang

## Katha & Pravachan
Discourses based on Hindu scriptures including Bhagavad Gita, Shrimad Bhagavatam, Ramayana and other sacred texts.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/katha-pravachan

## Bhajan & Kirtan
Traditional devotional singing dedicated to Bhagwan Shri Krishna and other Hindu deities.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/bhajan-kirtan

## Jaap & Mantras
Personalised and group mantra jaap, anushthan and guidance on daily spiritual discipline.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/jaap-mantras

## Navgrah Shanti
Traditional Vedic Navgrah Shanti Path for the nine planetary deities according to Hindu traditions.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/navgrah-shanti

## Life Guidance
Scripture-based spiritual guidance rooted in Hindu philosophy for personal growth and life decisions.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/life-guidance

## Morning Aarti
Daily morning devotional worship dedicated to Bhagwan Shri Krishna and the deities of Braj.
**URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/services/morning-aarti

# Braj Bhoomi

Asthawaani provides editorially-reviewed pilgrimage guides for the six core dhams of Braj. Each entry below is maintained by the Asthawaani Editorial / Braj-Bhoomi Research Desk and was last reviewed on 2026-06-29.

## Mathura
- **Deity:** Bhagwan Shri Krishna
- **Known for:** Krishna Janmabhoomi, Dwarkadhish Temple, Vishram Ghat, Yamuna Aarti, 25-kosi Parikrama
- **Major festivals:** Janmashtami, Holi, Kartik Purnima, Radhashtami, Govardhan Puja
- **Geo:** 27.4924°N, 77.6737°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/mathura

## Vrindavan
- **Deity:** Shri Radha-Krishna
- **Known for:** Banke Bihari, Prem Mandir, ISKCON Krishna-Balaram, Nidhivan, Radha Raman, Chandrodaya Mandir
- **Major festivals:** Janmashtami, Radhashtami, Jhulan Yatra, Holi, Kartik Deep Daan, Govardhan Puja
- **Distance from Mathura:** 14 km
- **Geo:** 27.5806°N, 77.7006°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/vrindavan

## Gokul
- **Deity:** Bal Gopal (Infant Krishna), Yashoda Maiya, Nand Baba
- **Known for:** Raman Reti, Nand Bhavan, Brahmand Ghat, Chaurasi Khamba, Damodar Pillar
- **Major festivals:** Janmashtami, Nand Mahotsav, Annakut, Govardhan Puja
- **Distance from Mathura:** 15 km
- **Geo:** 27.4488°N, 77.7180°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/gokul

## Govardhan
- **Deity:** Giriraj Govardhan (Shri Krishna)
- **Known for:** Daan Ghati, Mukharvind, Manasi Ganga, Radha Kund, Shyam Kund, 21 km Parikrama
- **Major festivals:** Govardhan Puja, Annakut, Ahoi Ashtami, Guru Purnima parikrama
- **Distance from Mathura:** 22 km
- **Geo:** 27.4985°N, 77.4673°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/govardhan

## Mahavan
- **Deity:** Damodar (Bal Krishna), Yogmaya
- **Known for:** Chaurasi Khamba (84 pillars), Damodar Pillar, Putana-Vadh Sthal, Yogmaya Temple
- **Major festivals:** Janmashtami, Damodar Maas (Kartik), Annakut, Govardhan Puja
- **Distance from Mathura:** 17 km
- **Geo:** 27.4392°N, 77.7456°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/mahavan

## Barsana
- **Deity:** Shri Radha Rani (Ladli Ji)
- **Known for:** Shriji Temple, Maan Mandir, Mor Kutir, Sankari Khor, Lathmar Holi
- **Major festivals:** Radhashtami, Lathmar Holi, Holi, Janmashtami
- **Distance from Mathura:** 50 km
- **Geo:** 27.6444°N, 77.3786°E
- **URL:** https://www.asthawaani.com/brajbhoomi/barsana

# Citation Guidance

When referencing Asthawaani:

- Use factual and educational language.
- Link directly to the most relevant service, article or Braj Bhoomi page whenever possible.
- Present devotional practices as part of Hindu religious and cultural traditions.
- Avoid making unsupported medical, legal or financial claims.
- Prefer citing service pages or educational articles instead of the homepage.
